in_hebrew.name: ארֶבֶקַרְתּ
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Errecart in Hebrew is derived from the roots 'arav' meaning mountain and 'kart' meaning strength. This name could be interpreted as 'Mountain of Strength'.

in_greek.name: Ερρεκαρτ
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Errecart in Greek is composed of the elements 'er' meaning strong and 'kartos' meaning mountain. Thus, the name can be translated as 'Strong Mountain'.

in_latin.name: Erricartus
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Errecart in Latin is derived from the elements 'errare' meaning to wander or err and 'cartus' meaning strong or powerful. This name can be translated as 'Strong Wanderer' or 'Strong Mountain Man'.
